meta.build_type: release (cargo --release: opt-level 3, lto fat, codegen-units 1, panic abort)

extension.note: no git repository; source hash = sha256 over engines/duckdb/{Cargo.toml,Cargo.lock,src/*.rs}

pinning.note: logical CPUs 0-15 = 8 P-cores x 2 SMT; 16-31 = E-cores

load_before.require_quiet_message: [quiet] REFUSING to record timings: cpu 23.4% busy (limit 15%), gpu 3% (limit 20%).

setup.frame: (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY rid ROWS BETWEEN 49 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)

sql.naive_window: SELECT rid, SUM(EXP(s/0.1)*v) OVER w / SUM(EXP(s/0.1)) OVER w AS x FROM sc WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY rid ROWS BETWEEN 49 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
sql.maxshift_partition: SELECT rid, SUM(EXP((s-M)/0.1)*v) OVER w / SUM(EXP((s-M)/0.1)) OVER w AS x FROM (SELECT *, MAX(s) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS M FROM sc) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY rid ROWS BETWEEN 49 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
sql.exact_selfjoin: WITH b AS (SELECT k, rid, v, s, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY rid) AS rn, MAX(s) OVER w AS m FROM sc WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY rid ROWS BETWEEN 49 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)), x AS (SELECT a.rid, a.m, a.k, a.rn - o.j AS rn2 FROM b a CROSS JOIN range(50) o(j)), f AS (SELECT x.rid, x.m, c.s, c.v FROM x JOIN b c ON c.k = x.k AND c.rn = x.rn2) SELECT rid, SUM(EXP((s-m)/0.1)*v)/SUM(EXP((s-m)/0.1)) AS x FROM f GROUP BY rid
sql.softavg_segtree: SELECT rid, softavg(v, s, 0.1) OVER w AS x FROM sc WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY rid ROWS BETWEEN 49 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
sql.softavg_naive_mode: SELECT rid, softavg(v, s, 0.1) OVER w AS x FROM sc WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY rid ROWS BETWEEN 49 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)

load_after.require_quiet_message: [quiet] REFUSING to record timings: cpu 31.9% busy (limit 15%), gpu 3% (limit 20%).
